problems.desc: Open task: draw a four-sided shape that is NOT a square and write one sentence naming what a square has that the drawing does not. Read the drawing and the sentence by hand. Any quadrilateral that is not a square earns credit (a rectangle that is longer than it is wide, a shape with a slanted corner, a shape with four unequal sides); the sentence must name an attribute, such as 'a square needs all four sides the same length' or 'a square needs four square corners'.
